test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Make out

options.text: Understand someone or something with difficulty
Run away from a difficult situation

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Understand someone or something with difficulty'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given phrase** 'Make out' **is **'Understand someone or something with difficulty'.**
 
• **Make out: **to deal with a situation, usually in a successful way. (किसी स्थिति से निपटने के लिए, आमतौर पर सफल तरीके से)
 
 
• Example*: She could **make out** only a dim line of woods behind her.**​​*
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Understand someone or something with difficulty.*
